name: ultra.learning
description: ULTRA Learning studio: which cell caused the miss, and is this fix safe to adopt? Improvement deltas, held-out scores and Brier changes are computed in code; Jev judges attribution and generality.

attribution.instructions: Which part of the system caused this miss

criteria.prompt: the instruction the cell was given was wrong or incomplete
criteria.rubric_wording: the rubric question is worded so a good artifact reads bad
criteria.threshold: the question is fine, the cut-off is wrong
criteria.routing: the work reached the wrong cell, level or studio
criteria.context: the right information never arrived in context
criteria.capability: the model or tool could not do it at all
criteria.impossible: no process would have caught it; the task was underdetermined

regression_risk.instructions: How much of the rest of the estate could this change disturb
criteria: no plausible way this breaks anything that works today
touches one prompt in one cell
touches a shared prompt several cells read
touches a gate threshold or routing that other missions depend on
touches enforcement, credentials, or an outward-facing surface

lesson_is_general.instructions: This lesson would help on a different mission, not just the one that produced it.

rubric_wording_defect.instructions: The false block came from how this rubric question is worded, not from the artifact or the threshold.

rules.reason: no write-back target: record it and move on, do not tune a cell
this change reaches shared or outward behaviour: it is Mike's call, not the loop's
one-off lesson: keep it in the cell's memory, do not promote it to a skill
reword the question and record the decision id that exposed it; do not soften the threshold

notes.attribution: doc signal l.attribution; routes the write-back to the producing cell. Seven slugs fixed at registration; add one only with a decision id that shows a real miss.
notes.rubric_wording_defect: doc signal l.rubric_wording_defect; provenance is s1gate's own first live run, 3 of 4 good artifacts false-blocked, two of them wording defects. Optimise against the false block.
